memories.author: patient
memories.text: Patient reports fatigue, occasional tingling in feet, and weight gain of 3 kg over past 2 months. No palpitations or heat intolerance.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

  Status: Likely deficient based on symptoms; serum B12 pending.

- Hypothyroidism

  Plan: Start levothyroxine 50 mcg OD on empty stomach.
- Weight & waist
